name: Non-parametric Transfer Function Generation using Spatial Variance
aliases: Kernel Density Estimation for TF Generation
definition: A technique for generating transfer functions by clustering volumetric data in an abstract feature space that combines scalar values with spatial variance statistics, using kernel density estimation to smooth the histogram and identify feature segments.
summary: This method enhances transfer functions by mapping histogram entries to spatial variance magnitude, solving background noise inclusion and incorrect feature segmentation common in conventional views.
